gaps.lead: The athlete denied taking performance-enhancing drugs.
gaps.explanation: deny + having + past participle (or deny taking).

gaps.lead: There were fewer people at the concert than expected.
gaps.sentence: There weren't ___ at the concert as expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (people) as expected.

gaps.lead: He finally managed to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = be able to do.

gaps.lead: Everybody says he is the best dentist in town.
gaps.sentence: He ___ the best dentist in town.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally believed to be.

gaps.lead: He started playing golf at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ golf at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby/sport): took up golf.

gaps.lead: He apologised because he was late.
gaps.explanation: apologise FOR + -ing: apologised for being late.
